proposal.name: Remember dismissed statues for the page

plan.name: Remember dismissed statues for the page
plan.summary: Fix delayed statue recovery in one plumbing change by keeping every excluded task ID in hook-local page-lifetime memory that survives rerenders and effect reruns, seeded from getDismissedStatueTaskId() during initialization before any latest-task answer can arrive. Add each fresh or recovered task only after onDeliver resolves successfully, add the last adopted task immediately on dismiss(), never replace earlier entries, and check the current collection after awaiting fetchLatestStatueTask() alongside cancellation, the running guard, the current stored dismissal and existing eligibility checks, even when storage is unavailable. Leave lib/statue.ts, its exports, the ask3d:dismissed-statue-task single-ID storage and existing successful-delivery/Clear writes unchanged; preserve the public hook API, health and start checks, guard through delivery, four-second poll waits, fifth-consecutive-failure stopping and response resets, queued/running or under-600-second succeeded recovery, all progress/error messages and delivery metadata, full-task-ID filenames with only the photo's final extension stripped, same-page retry names, recoverability of uncleared pending/rejected deliveries, and completion of in-flight delivery after Clear. Add the pinned public-interface regression coverage in lib/__tests__/statue-recovery.accept.test.ts without changing any existing tests or assertions in lib/__tests__/statue-task.accept.test.ts or lib/__tests__/statue-delivery.accept.test.ts, update README.md to explain page-lifetime exclusions and unchanged single-ID best-effort persistence across reloads, and run the new coverage, full Vitest suite, ESLint and typecheck. Merger work for a person after this complete step merges is to bring existing draft PR #31 up to date with main and rerun its existing #27/#31 gate against the fixed hook without changing its check or driver scenarios.

tests.name: LateAnswerAcrossDeliveries
tests.says: A recovered task is delivered once even when a still-live latest-task answer names it after a different fresh task finishes; filenames, idle progress, polling, downloads and the newer single stored ID remain correct, and an unrelated task can still recover.
tests.selector: statue recovery exclusions ignores a live delayed answer for an earlier recovered delivery after a fresh delivery

tests.name: DismissalPresentAtMount
tests.says: A task dismissed before mounting stays excluded when the initial latest-task answer arrives after a newer delivery has replaced its stored ID, without ever delivering the old task on this page.
tests.selector: statue recovery exclusions remembers the dismissal present at mount before any latest answer arrives

tests.name: ClearBeforeDeliveryRejects
tests.says: Clear immediately excludes the adopted task while delivery is pending, keeps the running guard through that delivery, and prevents a late answer from retrying it after rejection and a different successful delivery.
tests.selector: statue recovery exclusions keeps a cleared pending delivery excluded after rejection and a newer success

tests.name: ClearAfterGenerationFailure
tests.says: Clear remembers the last adopted task even if generation failed before downloading or delivering, and an eligible late answer cannot revive it after a newer delivery.
tests.selector: statue recovery exclusions remembers Clear after generation fails without reaching delivery

tests.name: UnavailableStorage1
tests.says: With localStorage reads and writes failing, successful recovered and fresh deliveries and an explicitly cleared rejected delivery stay excluded across rerenders and recovery effect reruns; only the existing single-ID storage writes are attempted.
tests.selector: statue recovery exclusions keeps delivered and cleared tasks excluded when storage is unavailable: reads and writes

tests.name: UnavailableStorage2
tests.says: With localStorage writes failing, successful recovered and fresh deliveries and an explicitly cleared rejected delivery stay excluded across rerenders and recovery effect reruns; only the existing single-ID storage writes are attempted.
tests.selector: statue recovery exclusions keeps delivered and cleared tasks excluded when storage is unavailable: writes

tests.selector: statue recovery exclusions keeps delivered and cleared tasks excluded when storage is unavailable: missing
